en: A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over a European city with dense tiled rooftops along a river with several bridges. In the left foreground there is a wooded hillside with a path and a pavilion-like structure. The bottom margin contains handwritten cursive text, and in printed red type the word "Graz" appears. The publisher credit "L. Strohschnedler, Graz" is printed in small red type at the lower left.
